text: {"lessons":["I should set forward-looking reasons and review points for each holding, rather than keep a losing stock merely to avoid admitting I was wrong.","Selling winners and later buying back without a fresh thesis can turn gains into costly churn; I should decide whether to hold or sell based on current prospects, not the comfort of a realized gain.","Before each trade, I should check its effect on the whole portfolio and keep enough cash and diversification to manage risk, instead of reacting to recent price moves."]}
